safeguards: The Step 14 football forecast is generated before and independently of sportsbook market data.
Market movement never rewrites the Step 14 projected score, margin, total, win probability, or football distribution.
Each market snapshot is evaluated at its own line and price so recommendations may change as price changes without changing the football forecast.
Two-way sportsbook prices are de-vigged with the Step 13 proportional method before model-vs-market probability edge is measured.
Spread and total push probability is modeled explicitly; model conditional win probability excludes pushes for fair-market comparison and push-aware EV treats pushes as zero return.
Moneyline tie probability is treated as a push/refund for two-way NFL moneyline evaluation.
A PICK requires probability edge, EV, and model conditional win probability to all clear the locked minimums; otherwise the output is PASS.
A recommendation is descriptive SHADOW_ONLY output and cannot place a wager, size a stake, or mutate football projections.
Closing prices are reserved for CLV/backtest evaluation and cannot be retroactively substituted for the price available at recommendation time.
Missing or incomplete two-sided prices produce no recommendation rather than an inferred market price.
